answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn, with the bond tied to one verified device credential so a single operator cannot clone free identities. Think of the bond as a ledge: cheap to stand on for one honest agent, but an attacker building a mesa of thousands of fake agents must fund every ledge separately, and slashing burns the bond when fraud is proven. A falcon-style reputation check that only counts work attested by independent peers then makes the cloned herd worthless, because fake votes never earn without real staked work.
